# GLASS paired GBM COL analysis

We hypothesize that when comparing primary and recurrent GBM, COLI and III expression will be upregulated in recurrent GBM. 

## Libraries
```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

BiocManager::install("EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75")
BiocManager::install("edgeR")
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
glass_dir  <- "/Data/Inputs/GLASS"
count_file <- file.path(glass_dir, "transcript_count_matrix_all_samples.tsv")

# Load entire matrix
counts_raw <- read.delim(
  count_file,
  check.names  = FALSE,
  comment.char = "",   # preserve any "#" lines
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Look at structure
head(counts_raw)
str(counts_raw[, 1:5])
```

```{r}

counts_tx <- counts_raw %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = colnames(counts_raw)[1])

```

## DE Analysis

Building Meta data from GLSS sample IDs

```{r}

# Rebuild metadata fresh from the current count matrix
sample_ids <- colnames(counts_tx)

# Use regex to pull out site, patient, and tumor code
# Pattern: GLSS-<SITE>-<PATIENT>-(TP or R1/R2/...)- 
m <- str_match(sample_ids, "^GLSS-([A-Z0-9]{2})-([A-Z0-9]+)-(TP|R[0-9]+)-")

meta2 <- tibble(
  sample_id  = sample_ids,
  site       = m[, 2],                                   # e.g. "19", "CU", "HF"
  patient_id = m[, 3],                                   # raw patient code, can start with letter
  patient    = ifelse(is.na(m[, 2]) | is.na(m[, 3]),
                      NA_character_,
                      paste0("GLSS-", m[, 2], "-", m[, 3])),  # full patient ID
  tumor_code = m[, 4],                                   # "TP", "R1", "R2", etc.
  tumor_type = case_when(
    tumor_code == "TP"             ~ "Primary",
    str_detect(tumor_code, "^R")   ~ "Recurrent",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
)

# Look at what we got
head(meta2)
table(meta2$tumor_type, useNA = "ifany")
sum(is.na(meta2$patient))

```

Filtering data to only include paired samples. 
```{r}
# 1) Identify patients with BOTH Primary and Recurrent samples
paired_patients <- meta2 %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  summarise(n_types = n_distinct(tumor_type), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_types == 2) %>%
  pull(patient)

length(paired_patients)  # how many patients are truly paired?

# 2) Keep only samples from those paired patients
meta_paired2 <- meta2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(patient %in% paired_patients)

# 3) Subset counts to those samples
counts_tx2 <- counts_tx[, meta_paired2$sample_id]

# 4) Align metadata order to count matrix columns
meta_paired2 <- meta_paired2[match(colnames(counts_tx2), meta_paired2$sample_id), ]

# 5) Sanity checks
table(meta_paired2$tumor_type)
length(unique(meta_paired2$patient))
all(colnames(counts_tx2) == meta_paired2$sample_id)

```

Build transcript for gene mapping and clean ENST ID
```{r}

## Transcript → gene mapping and aggregation to gene level

edb <- EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75

# 1) Transcript → gene mapping from EnsDb
tx_annot <- transcripts(
  edb,
  columns = c("tx_id", "gene_name"),
  return.type = "DataFrame"
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    tx_id_clean = sub("\\..*$", "", tx_id)   # drop version suffix
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(tx_id_clean, gene_name) %>%
  distinct()

# 2) Clean GLASS transcript IDs in the paired count matrix
counts_tbl <- counts_tx2 %>%
  rownames_to_column("raw_tx") %>%
  mutate(
    tx_id_clean = sub("\\|.*$", "", raw_tx),       # drop anything after '|'
    tx_id_clean = sub("\\..*$", "", tx_id_clean)   # drop version suffix
  )

# 3) Join counts with annotation
merged <- inner_join(counts_tbl, tx_annot, by = "tx_id_clean")

nrow(merged)
length(unique(merged$gene_name))

# 4) Aggregate transcript counts → gene-level counts for paired samples
sample_cols <- colnames(counts_tx2)

counts_gene_paired2 <- merged %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  group_by(gene_name) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(sample_cols), ~ sum(as.numeric(.))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_name") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Diagnostics
dim(counts_gene_paired2)
head(counts_gene_paired2[, 1:5])
summary(as.numeric(counts_gene_paired2))

```
### Run limma
```{r}
# 1) Make sure metadata is properly typed
meta_paired2 <- meta_paired2 %>%
  mutate(
    patient    = factor(patient),
    tumor_type = factor(tumor_type, levels = c("Primary", "Recurrent"))  # Primary = baseline
  )

# 2) Build DGEList from gene-level paired counts
y <- DGEList(counts = counts_gene_paired2)

# 3) Filter out ultra-lowly expressed genes
keep <- rowSums(y$counts) >= 10
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# 4) TMM normalization
y <- calcNormFactors(y)

# 5) Design matrix: patient term (paired) + tumor_type effect
design <- model.matrix(~ patient + tumor_type, data = meta_paired2)

# 6) Voom transform
v <- voom(
  y,
  design,
  plot = FALSE
)

# 7) Fit linear model
fit <- lmFit(v, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

# 8) Extract Recurrent vs Primary results
limma_res <- topTable(
  fit,
  coef   = "tumor_typeRecurrent",  # Recurrent vs Primary
  number = Inf,
  sort.by = "P"
)

head(limma_res)

```
```{r}
## Save limma results (paired DEGs) as CSV
outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/GLSS"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

deg_file <- file.path(outdir, "GLASS_paired_DEGs_Recurrent_vs_Primary.csv")
write.csv(limma_res, deg_file, row.names = TRUE)

```


### DEG visualizaiton

Volcano plot
```{r}
## Volcano plot with COL1A1, COL1A2, COL3A1 highlighted
 
# genes of interest
col_genes <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1")

# prepare volcano df
volc_df <- limma_res %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p = -log10(P.Value),
    sig_class = case_when(
      adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0  ~ "Up in Recurrent",
      adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0  ~ "Down in Recurrent",
      TRUE                          ~ "NS"
    ),
    highlight = gene %in% col_genes
  )

ggplot(volc_df, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_p)) +
  # background points
  geom_point(aes(color = sig_class), alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +

  # highlighted COL genes
  geom_point(
    data = subset(volc_df, highlight),
    color = "red", size = 3
  ) +

  # label the COL genes
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(volc_df, highlight),
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 4,
    color = "red",
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Up in Recurrent"   = "firebrick",
    "Down in Recurrent" = "dodgerblue3",
    "NS"                = "grey75"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "log2 fold-change (Recurrent vs Primary)",
    y = "-log10(p-value)",
    title = "Volcano Plot with COL1/3 Genes Highlighted",
    color = "DE Class"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```
Slope Plot

```{r}
## Save jittered paired slope plots for COL genes

outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/GLSS"
col_genes <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1")

for (g in col_genes) {

  df_g <- col_long %>% dplyr::filter(gene == g)

  # Aggregate to one expression value per patient per tumor type
  df_g_wide <- df_g %>%
    group_by(patient, tumor_type) %>%
    summarise(expr = mean(expr), .groups = "drop")

  # Convert back to long for plotting
  df_g_plot <- df_g_wide %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = tumor_type, values_from = expr) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c("Primary", "Recurrent"),
      names_to = "tumor_type",
      values_to = "expr"
    )

  p <- ggplot(df_g_plot, aes(x = tumor_type, y = expr, group = patient)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0),
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Paired Primary → Recurrent Expression:", g),
      x = "",
      y = "voom log2 expression"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  # Save plot
  outfile <- file.path(outdir, paste0("SlopePlot_", g, "_Paired_Jittered.pdf"))
  ggsave(outfile, p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
}

```

```{r}
## Paired Wilcoxon tests for COL genes (aggregated per patient)

col_genes <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1")

for (g in col_genes) {
  cat("\n===== ", g, " =====\n")
  
  # Subset to this gene
  df_g <- col_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene == g)
  
  # Collapse to one value per patient per tumor_type (mean across blocks)
  df_g_wide <- df_g %>%
    dplyr::group_by(patient, tumor_type) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(expr = mean(expr), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from  = tumor_type,
      values_from = expr
    ) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(Primary, Recurrent)
  
  # Paired Wilcoxon test (Primary vs Recurrent within patient)
  test <- wilcox.test(df_g_wide$Primary, df_g_wide$Recurrent, paired = TRUE)
  print(test)
}

```
